name: collision2d
description: Boxes that know when they overlap: walls and floors that stop moving entities, and a count of what an entity is touching. It works on positions only, so it does not depend on drawing and runs the same with or without a window.

components.name: Collider
components.description: An axis-aligned box of the given width and height centred on the entity's Position. layer says what the entity is, mask says which layers it reacts to. Both are sets of names from the game's layer list (for example ["wall"], or ["player", "enemy"] for a mask) or plain bit sets (1 is the first name, 2 the second, 4 the third...). solid makes it a wall that stops every Body whose mask includes its layer.

components.name: Body
components.description: The entity is pushed out of solid colliders (and loses the speed that went into them) instead of crossing them. Needs a Collider. Moves faster than its own size in one tick can jump over a thin wall: keep walls at least as thick as the fastest body travels per tick.

components.name: Contacts
components.description: Filled in every tick for an entity that also has a Collider: count is the number of other colliders overlapping it whose layer is in its mask, and layers is the union of their layers. Boxes that only share an edge do not overlap. Put it on the entities that need to know what they touch.

systems.name: block
systems.description: Pushes every Body out of the solid colliders it overlaps, along the shortest way out, and cancels its Velocity towards the wall. Entities are handled in creation order, so the result is the same on every run.

systems.name: detect
systems.description: Counts what every Contacts entity touches, after bodies have been moved out of walls.
